statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); git_info=''; if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'detached'); status=''; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then status=' *'; fi; git_info=" (${branch}${status})"; fi; printf "%s@%s:%s%s [%s]" "$user" "$host" "$cwd" "$git_info" "$model"
